ReferencesAndLinks: Javier Gonzalez-Castillo, Ziad S. Saad, Daniel A. Handwerker, Souheil J. Inati, Noah Brenowitz, and Peter A. Bandettini Whole-brain, time-locked activation with simple tasks revealed using massive averaging and model-free analysis PNAS 2012 109 (14) 5487-5492; doi:10.1073/pnas.1121049109

latestSnapshot.readme:
Three subjects were scanned on a General Electric 3T MRI scanner. All subjects underwent 100 functional runs
, which consisted of five blocks of stimulation (20 s: flickering checkerboard at 8 Hz + letter/number discr
imination task) and 40 s of rest. For the letter/number discrimination task, subjects responded using a resp
onse box with their right hand.
